svg.title: 09 three tier architecture
svg.desc: Conceptual production architecture. Apache serves the Vite static build and PHP API. JSON/SSE application exchange and ArcadeDB REST/SQL retrieval are distinct from static asset delivery. Ollama is optional; it does not enumerate factual results. Domain boxes summarize the schema connection, not a complete instance graph. Numbered tiers match Figure 10. No benchmark or clinical-validity claim.
